# Config Reference

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_config_reference.py. Do not edit this file by hand. -->

This is the single-page reference for `deberta train` YAML/JSON configs and dotted CLI overrides.
It is generated from `src/deberta/config.py` dataclass leaves and validation constants, with per-key
interaction notes maintained in the generator. Regenerate with:

```bash
conda run --name neobert --no-capture-output python tools/generate_config_reference.py --write
```

Only these top-level config sections are accepted: `model`, `data`, `train`, `optim`, and `logging`.
`variables` may be used for interpolation before validation, but it is removed before dataclass
construction and is not a runtime config section. Unknown keys fail validation.

Dotted CLI overrides use the exact same leaf names shown below, for example
`--train.max_steps 2000 --optim.scheduler.warmup_steps 200`. CLI overrides take precedence over
config-file values. `deberta train --preset deberta-v3-base` is available; with a config file it only
overrides model fields, and without a config file it supplies model/data/train/optim/logging defaults.
`--dry-run` validates config and runtime preflight without training or writing checkpoints, but may
still touch tokenizer/dataset network caches.

Profile/backbone effective defaults run after file/CLI parsing. The YAML below shows literal dataclass
defaults; keys whose effective default can change say so on the key itself.

## Minimal Valid Skeleton

```yaml
data:
  source:
    dataset_name: "HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu"
```

Everything else can be omitted and will use documented defaults, but real training runs should set
`train.checkpoint.output_dir`, `logging.output_dir`, and explicit model/data sizing for reproducibility.

## Full Reference

```yaml
# Model/backbone, tokenizer, embedding sharing, dropout, and FlashDeBERTa policy.
model:
  # Type: str. Default: "modern". Required: no. Valid values: `deberta_v3_parity` | `modern`.
  # Guidance: Selects profile-level effective defaults. `deberta_v3_parity` preserves DeBERTa-v3 RTD conventions and changes several train/optim defaults when those keys are unset.
  profile: "modern"
  # Type: str. Default: "hf_deberta_v2". Required: no. Valid values: `hf_deberta_v2` | `rope`.
  # Guidance: `hf_deberta_v2` is the native DeBERTa-v2/v3 parity backbone. `rope` is the modern RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU-capable path and is the preferred speed baseline.
  backbone_type: "hf_deberta_v2"
  # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
  # Guidance: When `false`, `model.pretrained.discriminator_path` is required. RoPE pretrained mode requires DebertaRoPE checkpoints, not Microsoft HF DeBERTa checkpoints.
  from_scratch: true
  # Type: str. Default: "gdes". Required: no. Valid values: `es` | `gdes` | `none`.
  # Guidance: `gdes` is recommended. `es` shares embeddings and is incompatible with `train.decoupled_training=true`; if using `es`, `optim.lr.generator` must inherit or equal `optim.lr.base`.
  embedding_sharing: "gdes"
  # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Enables backbone gradient checkpointing. Useful for memory pressure, but slower and only worth enabling after checking throughput.
  gradient_checkpointing: false
  tokenizer:
    # Type: str. Default: "microsoft/deberta-v3-base". Required: no.
    # Guidance: Tokenizer id/path. Must be non-empty. Use a vocab compatible with pretrained checkpoints unless `model.from_scratch=true`.
    name_or_path: "microsoft/deberta-v3-base"
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Allows embedding resize when tokenizer vocab differs from model config. Use only when intentionally changing vocab shape.
    allow_vocab_resize: false
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Optional target vocab size. If set, must be > 0. Usually leave `null`; `vocab_multiple` handles padding to efficient multiples.
    vocab_target: null
    # Type: int. Default: 1. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Vocabulary size multiple for resize/padding. Must be >= 1. Use 128 for tensor-core-friendly vocab padding when resizing.
    vocab_multiple: 1
  hf:
    # Type: str. Default: "base". Required: no. Valid values: `base` | `large` | `small` | `xsmall`.
    # Guidance: Native HF DeBERTa-v2/v3 model size preset. Applies only when `model.backbone_type=hf_deberta_v2`; ignored with a warning for `rope`.
    model_size: "base"
    # Type: str. Default: "dynamic". Required: no. Valid values: `cached_bmm` | `dynamic` | `stable`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `cache` -> `cached_bmm`, `cached` -> `cached_bmm`, `compile_safe` -> `stable`, `default` -> `dynamic`, `safe` -> `stable`.
    # Guidance: Native eager DeBERTa attention implementation choice. Applies only to `hf_deberta_v2`; ignored for `rope`.
    attention_kernel: "dynamic"
    # Type: str. Default: "eager". Required: no. Valid values: `eager` | `flash`.
    # Guidance: `eager` is the portability default. `flash` is valid only with `model.backbone_type=hf_deberta_v2`, requires dropout disabled, and uses the JSON route/kernel policy under `model.hf.flash.*`. Route/kernel defaults are capability-scoped (measured rows ship for `sm_120`); other GPUs run flash with conservative defaults - see `docs/advanced/gpu-support.md`.
    attention_impl: "eager"
    flash:
      # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Experimental routing override that forces padded batches onto varlen route; use only for benchmarking/debugging.
      force_varlen: false
      # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Optional varlen threshold. `null` uses the JSON route table; if set, must be > 0.
      varlen_min_seq_len: null
      # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Exact-length dense doc-block route override. `null` uses the JSON table, which selects dense `docblock_bias` for measured packed `1024`/`2048`/`4096` buckets on `sm_120` and ragged `docblock` elsewhere (other hardware and unlisted shapes). Set a positive exact sequence length to force dense only at that length on any GPU; set `0` to force-disable dense doc-block routing and use ragged segment metadata. A positive value bypasses the table's `max_batch_size`/`max_seq_len` safety bounds - the dense route saves a `(B,H,S,S)` bias for backward, so a stale knob plus a larger batch can OOM; training warns once when the knob forces dense past the bounds. Clear it after tuning experiments.
      docblock_bias_seq_len: null
      # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Dense local-bias route seq-len override for plain (non-packed) batches. `null` uses table policy (shipped rows are `sm_120`-scoped, so the route stays off on other GPUs); `0` disables the local-bias route; a positive value allows it only at that exact sequence length. On hardware without table rows, set this together with `local_bias_max_batch_size`. Independent of `model.hf.flash.docblock_bias_seq_len`.
      local_bias_seq_len: null
      # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Dense local-bias route cap. `null` uses table policy; `0` disables. On hardware without table rows, set this together with `local_bias_seq_len` to opt in. Dense routes can be memory-heavy and hardware-sensitive.
      local_bias_max_batch_size: null
      # Type: int. Default: 0. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Debugging fallback threshold. Must be >= 0. Leave `0` unless explicitly comparing eager dense attention inside flash experiments.
      eager_dense_max_seq_len: 0
      # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Only used when `model.hf.attention_impl=flash`. Optional JSON tuning table path for flash route/kernel policies. Experimental; keep run-local and record with checkpoints for reproducibility.
      kernel_overrides_path: null
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: HF DeBERTa-v2/v3 max positions override. Only valid for `hf_deberta_v2` with `model.from_scratch=true`; must be > 0 if set.
    max_position_embeddings: null
  pretrained:
    # Type: str. Default: "". Required: conditional - required when `model.from_scratch=false`.
    # Guidance: Required when `model.from_scratch=false`. Use a discriminator checkpoint compatible with `model.backbone_type`.
    discriminator_path: ""
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Optional separate generator checkpoint. If set, `model.generator.*` shape overrides must be unset.
    generator_path: null
  generator:
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Scratch/derived generator layer-count override. Must be unset when `model.pretrained.generator_path` is provided.
    num_hidden_layers: null
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Scratch/derived generator hidden-size override. Invalid with `model.from_scratch=false` unless loading a separate generator checkpoint.
    hidden_size: null
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Scratch/derived generator FFN-size override. Leave `null` to derive from profile/backbone defaults.
    intermediate_size: null
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Scratch/derived generator attention-head override. Hidden size must remain divisible by heads in the built backbone.
    num_attention_heads: null
  rope:
    # Type: int. Default: 768. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE scratch hidden size. Only valid when `model.backbone_type=rope` and `model.from_scratch=true`; must be > 0 and divisible by heads.
    hidden_size: 768
    # Type: int. Default: 12. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE scratch layer count. Only valid for scratch RoPE; must be > 0.
    num_hidden_layers: 12
    # Type: int. Default: 12. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE scratch attention heads. Only valid for scratch RoPE; must be > 0 and divide `model.rope.hidden_size`.
    num_attention_heads: 12
    # Type: int. Default: 3072. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE scratch FFN width before optional SwiGLU adjustment. Must be > 0.
    intermediate_size: 3072
    # Type: str. Default: "gelu". Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE scratch hidden activation name passed into the backbone. Use `gelu` for BERT-style parity unless intentionally experimenting.
    hidden_act: "gelu"
    # Type: float. Default: 10000.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE base theta for scratch models. Larger values extend long-context bias; default is standard 10000.
    rope_theta: 10000.0
    # Type: float. Default: 1.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Fraction of each head using RoPE. Must be in (0, 1]. Use 1.0 unless reproducing partial-rotary ablations.
    rotary_pct: 1.0
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Adds learned absolute position embeddings to RoPE scratch models. Usually keep false; enabling changes the modern baseline.
    use_absolute_position_embeddings: false
    # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Optional scratch RoPE max positions. If set, must be > 0. Leave `null` to derive from data/context builder.
    max_position_embeddings: null
    # Type: int. Default: 2. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE token-type embedding size. Use 0/1/2 depending on segment-id needs; default 2 matches BERT-style inputs.
    type_vocab_size: 2
    # Type: str. Default: "post". Required: no. Valid values: `keel` | `post`.
    # Guidance: `post` is standard LayerNorm placement. `keel` enables KEEL scaling and activates `keel_alpha_*` controls.
    norm_arch: "post"
    # Type: float. Default: 1e-06. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE norm epsilon. Must be positive in practice; default 1e-6 is recommended for bf16 stability.
    norm_eps: 1e-06
    # Type: float | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Only used when `model.rope.norm_arch=keel`; ignored with a warning for `post`.
    keel_alpha_init: null
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Only used when `model.rope.norm_arch=keel`; ignored with a warning for `post`.
    keel_alpha_learnable: false
    # Type: str. Default: "sdpa". Required: no. Valid values: `eager` | `sdpa`.
    # Guidance: `sdpa` uses PyTorch scaled dot-product attention and is recommended. `eager` is for debugging/parity.
    attention_implementation: "sdpa"
    # Type: str. Default: "mlp". Required: no. Valid values: `mlp` | `swiglu`.
    # Guidance: `mlp` is BERT-style. `swiglu` is experimental-modern; if enabled, `swiglu_adjust_intermediate` controls width adjustment.
    ffn_type: "mlp"
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Adds linear biases in RoPE modules. Keep false for the modern baseline unless matching a checkpoint that used biases.
    use_bias: false
    # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Only used when `model.rope.ffn_type=swiglu`; ignored with warning for `mlp`.
    swiglu_adjust_intermediate: true
    # Type: float. Default: 0.02. Required: no.
    # Guidance: RoPE scratch initializer standard deviation. Default 0.02 follows BERT/DeBERTa convention.
    initializer_range: 0.02
    pretrained:
      # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only override. Only valid when `model.backbone_type=rope` and `model.from_scratch=false`; must be > 0 if set.
      max_position_embeddings: null
      # Type: float | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only theta override. Use only to adapt a known compatible checkpoint.
      rope_theta: null
      # Type: float | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only rotary fraction override. If set, must be in (0, 1].
      rotary_pct: null
      # Type: bool | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only absolute-position override. Use only when the checkpoint/config expects it.
      use_absolute_position_embeddings: null
      # Type: int | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only token-type vocab override. Use only when adapting a compatible checkpoint.
      type_vocab_size: null
      # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no. Valid values: `keel` | `post`.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only norm architecture override.
      norm_arch: null
      # Type: float | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only norm epsilon override.
      norm_eps: null
      # Type: float | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only KEEL alpha init override. Applies only to KEEL checkpoints.
      keel_alpha_init: null
      # Type: bool | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only KEEL alpha learnable override. Applies only to KEEL checkpoints.
      keel_alpha_learnable: null
      # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no. Valid values: `mlp` | `swiglu`.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only FFN type override.
      ffn_type: null
      # Type: bool | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only linear-bias override. Must match checkpoint architecture.
      use_bias: null
      # Type: float | None. Default: null. Required: no.
      # Guidance: Pretrained RoPE-only initializer override. Usually irrelevant when loading weights.
      initializer_range: null
  dropout:
    # Type: float | None. Default: 0.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Hidden dropout probability or `null`. Flash attention requires this to be null or 0.0; default disables dropout for parity/throughput.
    hidden_prob: 0.0
    # Type: float | None. Default: 0.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Attention-prob dropout probability or `null`. Flash attention requires this to be null or 0.0.
    attention_probs_prob: 0.0

# Dataset source, streaming, packing length, and cross-document mask behavior.
data:
  source:
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: conditional - one of `data.source.dataset_name`, `data.source.data_files`, or `data.source.load_from_disk` is required.
    # Guidance: HF dataset id/builder. At least one of `dataset_name`, `data_files`, or `load_from_disk` is required. Can combine with `data_files` for builders such as `text`.
    dataset_name: null
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: HF dataset config/subset name. Requires `data.source.dataset_name`; cannot be used with `load_from_disk`.
    dataset_config_name: null
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: conditional - one of `data.source.dataset_name`, `data.source.data_files`, or `data.source.load_from_disk` is required.
    # Guidance: Comma-separated local/remote data files. At least one source key is required. With no `dataset_name`, files are loaded via the HF `text` builder.
    data_files: null
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: conditional - one of `data.source.dataset_name`, `data.source.data_files`, or `data.source.load_from_disk` is required.
    # Guidance: Path to a dataset saved by HF `load_from_disk`. Requires `data.source.streaming=false` and cannot combine with `dataset_name`, `dataset_config_name`, or `data_files`.
    load_from_disk: null
    # Type: str. Default: "train". Required: no.
    # Guidance: Dataset split to train on. Must exist in the selected dataset/source.
    train_split: "train"
    # Type: str. Default: "text". Required: no.
    # Guidance: Column containing raw text. Must exist in the loaded dataset examples.
    text_column_name: "text"
    # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Use HF streaming. Required false with `load_from_disk`; true is recommended for large remote datasets.
    streaming: true
    # Type: int. Default: 10000. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Streaming reservoir shuffle buffer. Must be >= 0; for non-streaming data, only 0 or 1 are valid. Set 0 to disable shuffle.
    shuffle_buffer_size: 10000
  packing:
    # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Pack text into fixed-length training blocks. Required for `block_cross_document_attention=true`; recommended true for throughput.
    enabled: true
    # Type: int. Default: 512. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Packed block length / training sequence length. Must be >= 8. Longer doc-block masks can be O(S^2) on non-segment-aware backends.
    max_seq_length: 512
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Prevents attention across packed document boundaries. Requires packing enabled. For RoPE with strict `train.sdpa_kernel=flash`, this is invalid; use auto/mem_efficient/math.
    block_cross_document_attention: false

# Optimization loop, precision, DataLoader, compile, RTD objective, and checkpoint behavior.
train:
  # Type: int. Default: 42. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Base random seed used by training, dataloader shuffling, and reproducibility setup.
  seed: 42
  # Type: int. Default: 10000. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Number of optimizer steps. Must be >= 1. This is the primary duration control; there is no epoch-based scheduler in this trainer.
  max_steps: 10000
  # Type: int. Default: 4. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Micro-batch size per process. Must be >= 1. Effective tokens per optimizer step also multiply by `gradient_accumulation_steps`.
  per_device_train_batch_size: 4
  # Type: int. Default: 1. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Micro-batches per optimizer step. Must be >= 1. With token-weighted GA, losses are weighted by active token count.
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 1
  # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Weights accumulated losses by active tokens. Effective default stays true for `hf_deberta_v2`; recommended for packed/ragged batches.
  token_weighted_gradient_accumulation: true
  # Type: str. Default: "bf16". Required: no. Valid values: `bf16` | `no`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `0` -> `no`, `1` -> `bf16`, `bf16` -> `bf16`, `bfloat16` -> `bf16`, `false` -> `no`, `n` -> `no`, `no` -> `no`, `none` -> `no`, `off` -> `no`, `on` -> `bf16`, `true` -> `bf16`, `y` -> `bf16`, `yes` -> `bf16`.
  # Guidance: `bf16` is recommended on modern NVIDIA GPUs. `no` runs full precision and is slower/more memory-heavy.
  mixed_precision: "bf16"
  # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Enables TensorFloat-32 matmul policy where supported. Recommended true for speed on Ampere+ GPUs.
  tf32: true
  # Type: str. Default: "auto". Required: no. Valid values: `auto` | `flash` | `math` | `mem_efficient`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `efficient` -> `mem_efficient`, `flash_attention` -> `flash`, `flashattention` -> `flash`, `mem` -> `mem_efficient`, `mem-efficient` -> `mem_efficient`.
  # Guidance: PyTorch SDPA kernel policy. Only affects `model.backbone_type=rope` with `model.rope.attention_implementation=sdpa`; ignored with warning for `hf_deberta_v2`. `flash` is invalid with packed cross-document blocking because strict flash SDPA cannot consume doc-block masks.
  sdpa_kernel: "auto"
  # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Runs generator/discriminator optimizer phases separately. Incompatible with `model.embedding_sharing=es`; recommended true with `gdes`.
  decoupled_training: true
  dataloader:
    # Type: int. Default: 2. Required: no.
    # Guidance: DataLoader worker count. Must be >= 0. Use 0 for debugging; use >0 for streaming throughput if the dataset source is stable.
    num_workers: 2
    # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Pins CPU batches before GPU transfer. Recommended true for CUDA training.
    pin_memory: true
  compile:
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Enables `torch.compile` on selected model scopes. Experimental per route; compile failures are hard errors.
    enabled: false
    # Type: str. Default: "default". Required: no. Valid values: `default` | `max-autotune` | `max-autotune-no-cudagraphs` | `reduce-overhead`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `max_autotune` -> `max-autotune`, `max_autotune_no_cudagraphs` -> `max-autotune-no-cudagraphs`, `reduce_overhead` -> `reduce-overhead`.
    # Guidance: Torch compile mode. Only used when `train.compile.enabled=true`; otherwise ignored with a warning.
    mode: "default"
    # Type: str. Default: "auto". Required: no. Valid values: `auto` | `backbones` | `disc_encoder` | `disc_ffn` | `encoder` | `ffn` | `gen_encoder` | `gen_ffn`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `backbone` -> `backbones`, `both` -> `backbones`, `disc_encoder` -> `disc_encoder`, `disc_ffn` -> `disc_ffn`, `discriminator_encoder` -> `disc_encoder`, `discriminator_ffn` -> `disc_ffn`, `encoder` -> `encoder`, `encoders` -> `encoder`, `ffn` -> `ffn`, `ffns` -> `ffn`, `full` -> `backbones`, `gen_encoder` -> `gen_encoder`, `gen_ffn` -> `gen_ffn`, `generator_encoder` -> `gen_encoder`, `generator_ffn` -> `gen_ffn`.
    # Guidance: Compile target scope. Only used when compile is enabled. `auto` may downgrade for dynamic masks; `backbones` is the main stable scope.
    scope: "auto"
    # Type: str. Default: "inductor". Required: no. Valid values: `aot_eager` | `inductor`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `aot-eager` -> `aot_eager`.
    # Guidance: Torch compile backend. Only used when compile is enabled; `inductor` is recommended for CUDA.
    backend: "inductor"
  objective:
    # Type: float. Default: 0.15. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Fraction of active tokens selected for MLM/RTD corruption. Must be in (0, 1).
    mlm_probability: 0.15
    # Type: float. Default: 0.8. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Probability selected tokens become `[MASK]`. Must be >= 0 and with `random_token_prob` sum <= 1. Effective default becomes 1.0 for `hf_deberta_v2` when unset.
    mask_token_prob: 0.8
    # Type: float. Default: 0.1. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Probability selected tokens become random tokens. Must be >= 0 and with `mask_token_prob` sum <= 1. Effective default becomes 0.0 for `hf_deberta_v2` when unset.
    random_token_prob: 0.1
    # Type: int. Default: 1. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Maximum masking ngram span. Must be >= 1. Use 1 for simple token masking/parity.
    mlm_max_ngram: 1
    # Type: float. Default: 1.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Generator sampling temperature for RTD replacements. Must be > 0.
    sampling_temperature: 1.0
    # Type: float. Default: 1.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Generator MLM loss weight. Use 1.0 unless intentionally rebalancing RTD phases.
    gen_loss_weight: 1.0
    # Type: float. Default: 50.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Discriminator RTD loss weight. Effective default becomes 10.0 for `hf_deberta_v2` when unset; raw dataclass default is 50.0.
    disc_loss_weight: 50.0
  checkpoint:
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Checkpoint directory. If null, runtime chooses/derives an output path. Also seeds logging output when `logging.output_dir=null`.
    output_dir: null
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Deletes/reuses an existing output dir. Cannot combine with `resume_from_checkpoint`; dangerous if pointing at a run you need.
    overwrite_output_dir: false
    # Type: int. Default: 1000. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Checkpoint interval in optimizer steps. Must be >= 0; 0 disables periodic saves. Final export is controlled separately.
    save_steps: 1000
    # Type: int. Default: 3. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Number of checkpoints to keep. Must be >= 0; 0 means no retention limit enforcement.
    save_total_limit: 3
    # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Checkpoint path to resume from, or null. Cannot combine with `overwrite_output_dir=true`.
    resume_from_checkpoint: null
    # Type: str. Default: "auto". Required: no. Valid values: `auto` | `replay` | `restart_epoch`.
    # Guidance: `auto` chooses replay/restart behavior. `replay` attempts deterministic dataloader replay; `restart_epoch` restarts data order.
    resume_data_strategy: "auto"
    # Type: int. Default: 10000. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Replay budget for resume data alignment. Must be >= 0. Higher values improve exact replay tolerance but cost startup time.
    resume_replay_max_micro_batches: 10000
    # Type: bool. Default: true. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Exports final discriminator HF artifacts after successful training. Disable for benchmark/probe runs to avoid extra final work.
    export_hf_final: true

# Optimizer, scheduler, learning rates, weight decay, and gradient clipping.
optim:
  lr:
    # Type: float. Default: 0.0005. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Base AdamW learning rate. Must be > 0. Used by both phases unless generator/discriminator LR override is positive.
    base: 0.0005
    # Type: float. Default: -1.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: `-1` inherits `optim.lr.base`; otherwise must be > 0. With `embedding_sharing=es`, must inherit or match base.
    generator: -1.0
    # Type: float. Default: -1.0. Required: no.
    # Guidance: `-1` inherits `optim.lr.base`; otherwise must be > 0.
    discriminator: -1.0
  adam:
    # Type: float. Default: 0.9. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Adam beta1. Typical value 0.9.
    beta1: 0.9
    # Type: float. Default: 0.999. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Adam beta2. Typical value 0.999.
    beta2: 0.999
    # Type: float. Default: 1e-08. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Adam epsilon. Effective default becomes 1e-6 for `hf_deberta_v2` when unset; raw default is 1e-8.
    epsilon: 1e-08
  scheduler:
    # Type: str. Default: "linear". Required: no. Valid values: `constant` | `constant_with_warmup` | `cosine` | `cosine_with_restarts` | `linear` | `polynomial`.
    # Guidance: Learning-rate scheduler type passed to Transformers scheduler factory.
    type: "linear"
    # Type: int. Default: 1000. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Warmup optimizer steps. Must be >= 0. Effective default becomes 10000 for `hf_deberta_v2` when unset.
    warmup_steps: 1000
  # Type: float. Default: 0.01. Required: no.
  # Guidance: AdamW weight decay. Must be >= 0. Default 0.01 is the recommended starting point.
  weight_decay: 0.01
  # Type: float. Default: 1.0. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Gradient clipping norm. Must be >= 0; 0 disables clipping.
  max_grad_norm: 1.0

# Local tracker, W&B, output directories, and debug metric logging.
logging:
  # Type: str. Default: "deberta-train". Required: no.
  # Guidance: Tracker/project name. Must be non-empty. Used for W&B project and local run metadata.
  project_name: "deberta-train"
  # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Optional run name. If null, runtime derives one from output/run context.
  run_name: null
  # Type: str | None. Default: null. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Directory for resolved/original config snapshots and logs. If null, defaults to `train.checkpoint.output_dir`.
  output_dir: null
  # Type: int. Default: 50. Required: no.
  # Guidance: Metric logging interval in optimizer steps. Must be >= 0; 0 disables periodic scalar logging.
  logging_steps: 50
  # Type: str. Default: "none". Required: no. Valid values: `none` | `tensorboard`.
  # Guidance: Local backend when W&B is disabled. Ignored when `logging.wandb.enabled=true` because effective backend is W&B.
  backend: "none"
  wandb:
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Enables W&B tracking. Requires W&B auth/environment outside config. When true, `logging.backend` is not the effective tracker.
    enabled: false
    # Type: str. Default: "gradients". Required: no. Valid values: `all` | `gradients` | `none` | `parameters`. Accepted CLI/config aliases: `0` -> `none`, `disabled` -> `none`, `false` -> `none`, `grad` -> `gradients`, `gradient` -> `gradients`, `off` -> `none`, `param` -> `parameters`, `params` -> `parameters`, `weights` -> `parameters`.
    # Guidance: W&B model watch mode. Only applies when `logging.wandb.enabled=true`; otherwise ignored with warning if changed.
    watch: "gradients"
    # Type: int. Default: 100. Required: no.
    # Guidance: W&B watch frequency. Must be >= 1 and only applies when W&B is enabled.
    watch_log_freq: 100
  debug:
    # Type: bool. Default: false. Required: no.
    # Guidance: Logs extra debug metrics. Useful for diagnosis; can add overhead and noise in benchmark runs.
    metrics: false
```

## Drift Check

The checked-in reference is expected to match the generator exactly:

```bash
conda run --name neobert --no-capture-output python tools/generate_config_reference.py --check
```
